name: Assistant
description: A language model of your choice (model-runtime, Ollama, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible server) for a chat pane, typo fixes and prompt review before you send to an agent, command suggestions and completions at the prompt, editor completions and Explain error. Nothing is sent until you pick a provider.

apiKey.description: API key for OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or an OpenAI-compatible server that needs one. Stored encrypted on this computer, never synced.

provider.description: Where requests go. none sends nothing.

baseUrl.description: Provider address: http(s) URL or unix:/path.sock. Empty uses the provider's default (model-runtime: $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/model-runtime.sock, Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1). Required for openai-compatible.

fastModel.description: Small, fast model for typo fixes, prompt review, command suggestions and completions (model-runtime: gemma when empty). Settings → Assistant → Models lists what the provider has.

chatModel.description: Model for the chat pane and Ask. Empty uses fastModel.

typos.description: Offer typo fixes for prompts you compose for an agent

promptReview.description: Review the quality of prompts you compose for an agent

commandSuggest.description: Suggest a shell command from a plain-language request at the prompt

terminalCompletions.description: Ghost-text completion of the command you are typing at a shell prompt (sends the line, the folder, recent commands with exit codes and pane chips such as the git branch; never output)

editorCompletions.description: Inline completions in the editor (sends the code around the cursor)

chat.description: The assistant chat pane and Ask in the command palette

explainError.description: Explain error on a failed command block (sends that command and its output when you click it)

requestsPerMinute.description: Most requests per minute for each feature (1 to 600)
